formal_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (A B C : Submodule ℂ (Fin m → ℂ)), (∀ x ∈ A ⊔ B, ∀ y ∈ A ⊔ B, ∑ i, x i * y i = 0) → (∀ c ∈ C, (∀ a ∈ A, ∑ i, c i * a i = 0) ∧ (∀ b ∈ B, ∑ i, c i * b i = 0) ∧ ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ∑ i, c i * (a i * b i) = 0) → (∀ a ∈ A, ∑ i, a i ^ 4 = 0) → Module.finrank ℂ A + Module.finrank ℂ B + Module.finrank ℂ C ≤ m
plain_statement: A, B, C are linear subspaces of C^m. Assume the dot product vanishes on A + B; every vector of C is orthogonal to A, to B, and to every entrywise product a * b with a in A and b in B; and the sum of fourth powers vanishes on A. Then dim A + dim B + dim C <= m. Met with equality by A = 0 and B = C a maximal isotropic space for even m. Proof on paper by seat-gct-1 (notes/gct-086-core/t3/), through the checked product bound L-gct-065. It bounds a family of 4 by s level spaces on the L-gct-086 line.
title: Three subspaces: A + B isotropic, C orthogonal to A, B and A*B, and the fourth power sum zero on A, give dim A + dim B + dim C <= m
